brier_definition: mean(sum_k((p_k-one_hot_k)^2)); no division by K; range [0,2]
equal_study_definition: one globally weighted confusion matrix, row weight 1/n_records_in_source
uncertainty: Source cluster percentile bootstrap conditional on saved OOF predictions; no refitting; fold variability is not confidence interval
protocol_comparison: descriptive; different training information, no causal/significance claim
